info.title: SmartGN - Installation & Device Management
info.description: Properties, supply points, external IoT installers, installation requests, device provisioning and association history. Owns an independent PostgreSQL database and integrates through authenticated HTTP and durable events. Local fixtures do not establish productive external integration.

tags.name: Properties
tags.description: Principal-owned properties and preserved administrative history.

tags.name: Installers
tags.description: SUPERADMIN administration of external accredited IoT installers.

tags.name: Installation requests
tags.description: Provisional requests, verified purchases, assignments and installation state transitions.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Versioned associations, one-time credentials and asynchronous provisioning.

tags.name: Synchronization
tags.description: SUPERADMIN inspection and retry of durable synchronization operations.
